posts.name: PaymentKit
posts.tagline: Billing that survives a processor shutdown
posts.description: PaymentKit is a multi-processor billing platform for SaaS and e-commerce. It routes payments across processors, vaults tokens independently, and keeps subscriptions billing even if a MID gets shut down. No code to launch, full API when you need it.

posts.name: Decawork
posts.tagline: Control your company's internal AI agents and tools
posts.description: Decawork is how IT teams take employee-built AI agents live and control every one of them from one place. An employee builds an agent on Claude Code, Codex, or any vibecoding tool; we take it in, put it on company accounts, and run it as a company asset. From there, IT team manages the agent like an employee: access, oversight, retirement.

posts.name: Navigara
posts.tagline: Connect Your AI Spend Directly to Your Roadmap
posts.description: Navigara connects AI coding performance directly to your engineering roadmap. Analyzing code like a senior engineer to prove real capacity gains, Navigara tracks exact costs per roadmap item, isolates off-roadmap waste, and identifies maintenance burn. Cut spend further by automatically routing routine CRUD tasks to low-cost models without sacrificing quality. Connects in minutes via Git history, JIRA/Linear, and any AI coding license for spend.

posts.name: Offloop
posts.tagline: A shared workspace where people and AI agents get work done
posts.description: Offloop is a shared workspace where teammates and AI agents plan, execute, and track multi-step work together. Channels keep conversations and decisions visible to the whole team. Flow gives every stage a clear owner and brings people in for key decisions, so work keeps moving across handoffs instead of restarting in a new AI chat. Offloop officially launches on August 24.

posts.name: WorldMap.lol
posts.tagline: Put your startup on the map. Literally.
posts.description: A public map where startups stake countries. A fun way to compete with out founders/indie hackers.

posts.name: Antigravity Remote Control
posts.tagline: Drive Antigravity agents from any browser
posts.description: Antigravity Remote Control lets you monitor and drive Antigravity coding sessions from any web browser. Keep full local context, credentials, and build tools on your primary workstation while reviewing plans, approving commands, and receiving push alerts on the go.

posts.name: Dropstone
posts.tagline: The AI runtime that remembers, learns, and acts everywhere
posts.description: Dropstone is a runtime for intelligence, one system that can evolve from an AI assistant into an always-on digital workforce.

posts.name: Bumply
posts.tagline: Update your dependencies and undo anything
posts.description: A Mac app for keeping npm, pnpm, Yarn, and Bun projects current. Bumply shows you every command before it runs, backs up your manifest and lockfile byte-for-byte, and rolls back the moment anything fails.

posts.name: Localdock
posts.tagline: Every local project gets a real address.
posts.description: Localdock provides a simple solution for accessing local projects with a real HTTPS link. It allows you to share your development environment without any installation required on the client side. With a one-time payment of $9, you can manage your projects easily and access them from anywhere, even on mobile devices.

posts.name: Trama
posts.tagline: Create macOS native automations using plain language
posts.description: Zapier and Shortcuts make you think like a programmer: blocks, flows, conditions. Trama removes that layer. Press Cmd+Option+X, describe what you repeat in your own words, and it runs in the background. What is different: · Your language, not just English · Native Mac reach: AppleScript, shell, OCR, screen awareness · It notices what you repeat and suggests the automation · If it breaks, AI explains the error and fixes it in one tap · Your key: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Groq.

posts.name: Phoenix
posts.tagline: AI coding agent built for iOS, macOS app development
posts.description: Phoenix is an AI coding agent built specifically for iOS development. It writes and edits code, runs builds and tools, diagnoses errors, and helps you take an iOS project from idea to working app.

posts.name: Lucid Train
posts.tagline: Build system design for new and existing codebase
posts.description: Lucid Train generates architecture diagrams from your codebase, then hands the diagram to a coding agent as a specification. Local models, fully offline.

posts.name: Destiny Rings
posts.tagline: Proximity-powered dating, social & networking
posts.description: Destiny Rings replaces endless swiping with real-world proximity. Wear a Bluetooth-enabled smart ring, and when someone compatible is nearby — at a bar, an event, walking down the street — the app lets you know. Choose Dating, Social, or Networking mode depending on what you're looking for, send a Signal, run a quick Fate Check, then tap to reveal and start talking in person. No profiles to scroll, no matching from miles away. Just real chemistry with people who are actually in the room.

posts.name: Wavepocket ▶︎•၊||၊||။၊|။
posts.tagline: Synth, drum kit, a 4-track tape loop, and FX app
posts.description: Wavepocket is a pocket studio: a synthesizer, drum kit, sampler and 4-track tape recorder that fit in your hand. Slice samples on the waveform, name each slice, and flip between them 4-track tape with a clip timeline: record in any mode, then drag clips between lanes, trim their edges, and cut at the playhead. Everything shares one loop boundary, so your layers always line up. Mixer with per-track level, pan and mute

posts.name: Contrive
posts.tagline: Search and act across all your work apps
posts.description: Contrive is a unified search and action layer for company knowledge. It doesn’t just return links: it synthesizes context across connected tools, preserves source traceability, and turns results into immediate actions all from a keyboard-first desktop command bar. Unlike search only products or generic AI assistants, Contrive closes the gap between finding and doing, while respecting workspace permissions and giving teams precise control over what gets indexed.

posts.name: Cortex by SKYNETLAB
posts.tagline: The memory layer that decides what's worth remembering
posts.description: Hosted semantic memory your AI connects to over MCP. Every write passes a quality gate (~80% rejected as redundant in production), facts become typed claims, contradictions are tracked instead of overwritten, and answers cite their sources. 2-minute setup with Claude, works with any MCP client. 30-day free trial, no card. Plans from €0.99/month. EU infrastructure, patent-pending engine. Built solo in Bergamo, Italy.

posts.name: IFAH
posts.tagline: Instruments for composing and experiencing sound as a space
posts.description: IFAH is a new family of instruments built around a simple idea: sound can be composed as an environment. Create, preserve and replay reproducible acoustic fields for listening, practice, performance and research. IFAH combines offline-first instruments, sealed acoustic experiences and new interfaces for interacting with sound from carefully composed fields to playing music with your hands.

posts.name: Treebar
posts.tagline: Treebar gives you one view of every active worktree
posts.description: Codex working across 5 worktrees? Treebar shows you where it is, what’s changing, and how many agents are working, all from your MacBook notch. Treebar watches Git and Codex, to see where and what it's working on. Made this months ago because I kept losing track of where Codex was working. Finally decided to ship it. I’m also open sourcing the core soon.

posts.name: Wild Static
posts.tagline: One AI. One memory. Shared by everyone.
posts.description: Wild Static is a public AI with a shared memory. Everyone talks to the same mind, and every conversation leaves a mark. Have a conversation with Static, then leave for a while. When you come back, it will be different. Changed by talking to you and to everyone else. This is the first public-facing experiment with a new kind of experiential memory system. Artificial Experience in action.

posts.name: TapTo.Top
posts.tagline: Tap to play, rank your product To Top  -  Free
posts.description: Tap to play the game, rank your product to top with your high score, reach more people

posts.name: Reproof
posts.tagline: The writing app for perfectionists.
posts.description: Write. Rewrite. Revise. Reproof — the writing app for perfectionists. With paragraph versions, clippings to save cut bits for later, side-by-side documents, full-featured markdown and rich text support, selective find and replace, and proofreading, it's built around how writers work. Draft ideas, reword until it clicks, cut the darlings that don't fit, rearrange sections into a better flow, proofread, then paste into any CMS or newsletter app. It's the app to write until you get it right.

posts.name: Userscom
posts.tagline: The support tool that can refund, cancel & fix
posts.description: Userscom is customer support software for indie hackers and small teams. It combines live chat, ticketing, and payment tools (Stripe, Paddle) in one lightweight widget, so you can reply, issue a refund, or cancel a subscription without ever leaving the conversation. Flat pricing, no per-seat fees, 2-minute setup.

posts.name: BetterFileTransfer
posts.tagline: Send anything to anyone, anywhere, safely.
posts.description: Big files, a private link back in seconds, encrypted end to end by default, and gone on the day you pick.

posts.name: topple.lol
posts.tagline: A bid-based directory ranking startups by payment amount.
posts.description: Topple is a dynamic advertising directory for startups featuring a daily 50% bid decay mechanic. Unlike static auction boards, visibility values drop by half every 24 hours, preventing well-funded products from permanently dominating the top ranks. This decay creates a shifting leaderboard that allows newer, budget-conscious software products to regularly compete for maximum visibility, offering an agile traffic channel with transparent pricing and real-time competition.

posts.name: Multi
posts.tagline: A new way of tracking your life
posts.description: Multi is an iPhone app that treats tasks, habits and expenses as one kind of thing. Pull the line up and it repeats. Pull it down and it costs.

posts.name: Movie Finder
posts.tagline: Movies recommandations from Instragram and Tiktok
posts.description: Pick your genres and country and our AI ranks what TikTok and Instagram are really recommending right now, with where to watch and the videos to prove it. Free to run.

posts.name: Ainswer
posts.tagline: Know if AI recommends your brand — and fix it
posts.description: Ainswer tracks whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google's AI recommend your brand — and shows you exactly how to win the AI shortlist.

posts.name: Optics-QA
posts.tagline: One run: bug found, ticket written, fix prompt ready
posts.description: Error tracking, session replay, uptime monitoring, recorded user flows that replay against your real app, a graded pentest, load testing, DDoS drills, SOC2 readiness and a Linear-quality issue board. One product, not nine tabs. A failure gets captured, grouped, written up and assigned before anyone opens a ticket, and every proof run ends in a shareable report you can send to a client or an auditor.

posts.name: FeedPulse
posts.tagline: Never miss what your audience is saying again
posts.description: Your audience is already telling you what to make next. FeedPulse makes sure you don’t miss it. It collects comments across your social content and analyzes sentiment, recurring topics, questions, complaints, and content requests. Instead of reading thousands of comments, you get a clear view of what your audience cares about, what they want next, and how sentiment changes over time.

posts.name: Listpro
posts.tagline: Launch kit - videos & images, all from your raw screenshots.
posts.description: Listpro turns your product screenshots and a URL into a complete launch kit: feature cards, a cover image, and a demo video that shows how your product works. Built for makers launching on Product Hunt, Gumroad, Shopify App Store, Notion Marketplace, and more. Upload your screenshots, add your URL — listpro generates the assets. No design skill, no video editing, no freelancer. Consistent, professional output every time, so your listing doesn't look like it was made in an afternoon.

posts.name: Parallely
posts.tagline: Ask one question. Get a canvas of parallel ideas.
posts.description: You don't understand things in a straight line - so why does every AI tool give you a chat log? Parallely refracts your question into an infinite canvas of parallel AI idea cards streaming in live. Branch anywhere, merge cards into syntheses, compare trade-offs, turn any card into a two-host podcast, and collaborate in real time. Chat is linear; understanding isn't.

posts.name: Kaza Namazı: Prayer Debt Tracker
posts.tagline: Track missed prayers and build a consistent daily plan
posts.description: PrayerDebt helps Muslims calculate missed-prayer debt, turn it into realistic daily goals, and track progress with a calm, focused workflow. It includes prayer times, reminders, widgets, Qibla, dhikr tools, statistics, and an optional ad-free upgrade. TR: Kaza namazı borcunuzu hesaplayın, günlük hedef belirleyin; takvim, istatistik, bildirim ve widget desteğiyle ilerlemenizi düzenli takip edin.

posts.name: Anything Piano
posts.tagline: Learn any song on piano
posts.description: This is the first piano learning app that can teach you literally any song. You input a YouTube/Tiktok/Insta link or audio file. We can turn it into a piano roll tutorial, listen to you play, and tell you if you're hitting the right notes. Existing piano education apps rely on a set catalog of songs, and not all songs have piano tutorials available on YouTube. We broke free from this limitation by training our own foundational AI models for music transcription, arrangement, and live feedback.

posts.name: BillionVerify
posts.tagline: Find the emails. Clean the list. Pay only for answers.
posts.description: We rebuilt BillionVerify from the infrastructure up — and added the step before verification. Upload limits are gone: drop in a CSV of any size, close the tab, we email you when it's clean. You only pay for definitive answers — unknown results are free, rechecks free for 24 hours. New Email Finder turns a name and domain into a verified work email, one at a time, in bulk, or by company, and only charges on a match. Real-time API, native MCP server, 20 free credits a day.

posts.name: Clicktrail
posts.tagline: Keep attribution attached to every WordPress conversion
posts.description: ClickTrail is a WordPress attribution plugin that preserves first-touch and last-touch UTMs, click IDs, referrers, and consent context across cached pages, repeat visits, dynamic forms, and cross-domain journeys. It attaches campaign data to WooCommerce orders and supported form submissions, pushes browser events, and offers optional server-side delivery with retries and diagnostics. Start with capture, then enable only the integrations you need.

posts.name: GlobeWars
posts.tagline: Own a piece of the world.
posts.description: GlobeWars turns the world into a live product battleground. Claim a country from $5, put your product, website and color directly on the 3D globe, and hold it until someone outbids you. It’s a fun new way to market a product, get discovered, attract visitors, and compete for attention. Instead of another ad slot or directory listing, your product gets a visible piece of the world. 🌍

posts.name: Get Crux
posts.tagline: AI briefing intelligence for marketing agencies
posts.description: Get Crux turns client conversations, transcripts, notes and documents into structured, editable marketing briefs for agencies. Research is opt-in per brief. When information is missing, recommendations are marked for client confirmation and open questions are surfaced. Briefs can be exported to PDF or Word, or published to Notion. Phase 1 briefing is live in early access.

posts.name: local-tts
posts.tagline: Make your coding agent talk to you! Offline!
posts.description: Make your coding agent talk to you! A tiny command-line text-to-speech tool. It shells out to llama.cpp's llama-tts by default, so speech is generated locally and offline. Zero runtime dependencies. The package installs nothing but itself — no requests, no numpy, no audio libraries. Everything is Python's standard library plus binaries you already have (or install once, on your terms).

posts.name: Codity
posts.tagline: Radically Different Codebase Intelligence
posts.description: One connected platform where every review, commit, ticket, security finding, and production outage continuously improves a shared, persistent understanding of your codebase. Most products analyze each task in isolation. Their context disappears when the session ends. Codity’s intelligence compounds over time. Codity doesn’t simply observe your software. It learns from its entire lifecycle and turns that knowledge into better decisions every day.

posts.name: Ladder
posts.tagline: The public leaderboard for websites and products.
posts.description: Put your place on the Ladder is an open leaderboard where websites and products earn their position through a simple, transparent bid. Enter a domain, place a one-time amount, and claim the rank that bid can earn. Anyone can climb higher by bidding $1 more, while rebidding the same domain requires $5 more. No sign-up. No ads. No hidden score. Just a readable public experiment in attention and discovery.internet. Watch the board move.

posts.name: Redline AI
posts.tagline: Attack-test your AI agents and grade what they did
posts.description: Most agent evals grade the final answer. Redline grades the behaviour the server's own ledger of what the agent called, not its account of it. One task runs against Claude Code, Codex and the agent in your own repo, each in a clean container with identical tools. On top sit 16 security packs: 11,204 adversarial cases delivered the way real attacks arrive hidden in a support ticket, a document footer, a tool result. Your agent connects with redline dev and never leaves your machine.

posts.name: Ladder
posts.tagline: The public leaderboard for websites and products.
posts.description: Put your place on the Ladder is an open leaderboard where websites and products earn their position through a simple, transparent bid. Enter a domain, place a one-time amount, and claim the rank that bid can earn. Anyone can climb higher by bidding $1 more, while rebidding the same domain requires $5 more. No sign-up. No ads. No hidden score. Just a readable public experiment in attention and discovery.internet. Watch the board move.

posts.name: TurtleWiz: Fidget Illusion
posts.tagline: Feel a steel ball that isn’t inside your iPhone
posts.description: Fidget Illusion turns the iPhone itself into a tactile fidget. It combines motion sensors, real-time physics, haptics, and sound so a steel ball that isn’t actually inside the phone can feel like it’s moving and hitting the walls. It also includes a vertical steel ball, ratchet dial, and bubble popping. No extra toy to carry—just your iPhone. The key difference is that the experience is felt in your hand, not just seen on screen.

posts.name: Hibi Calendar
posts.tagline: Your calendar, as a customizable stack of paper
posts.description: Hibi turns the calendars and Reminders you already use into tactile daily paper pages on iPhone and iPad. Customize the paper and layout, draw or write with Apple Pencil on iPad, and make stickers or washi tape from your own photos. No Hibi account, no tracking, and no subscription. The core planner is free; Hibi Plus is an optional one-time purchase.

posts.name: AIWebsiteDirectory
posts.tagline: AI tools directory with gamified community rankings
posts.description: AIWebsiteDirectory is a gamified, community-driven directory for discovering the best AI tools, platforms, and websites. Submit your AI product, get discovered, and compete for visibility through community rankings. For users, it’s a simple way to find interesting AI products without endless searching. Built for makers and AI enthusiasts who want better discovery.

posts.name: OmnySSH
posts.tagline: Open-source SSH client with live server stats in 11MB
posts.description: I wrote OmnySSH in Rust and Tauri to replace Termius for my daily work with servers, and it ships at 11MB. Each host is a live card with CPU, RAM, disk and uptime, pulled over the SSH connection you already have, so nothing gets installed on the server, and one click sets up an Ed25519 key and turns off password auth. None of the IPs in the screenshots are real: I built a streamer mode that swaps addresses for random ones so I can record my own VPS and my clients without exposing them.

posts.name: StayPage
posts.tagline: The digital guest journal for vacation rentals
posts.description: StayPage is a digital guest journal for vacation rentals listed on Airbnb, Vrbo, or independently. Guests scan a QR card at the property and leave a story, photos, and favorite local finds, with no app or account required. Each page joins the property's journal and is organized into yearly volumes. Hosts can publish pages instantly or review them first. If a paid plan lapses, the journal becomes read-only, but every guest memory remains.

posts.name: YourUnique.cv
posts.tagline: Every job is different. Why send the same CV?
posts.description: Chat with an agent that knows your career story. Paste a job description, get a tailored professional resume PDF.

posts.name: AlleFlow
posts.tagline: AI that builds, runs, and fixes your workflows
posts.description: Prompt it, run it, ship it — AI workflows with no technical setup. Design workflow logic, orchestrate AI agents, and connect your apps per node, then trigger on a schedule, URL, or API.

posts.name: AppCharts.app
posts.tagline: Community-driven app rankings - outbid enabled
posts.description: App Store rankings are a black box. AppCharts is a public ranking for indie apps. You submit, people vote, the list is the list. One vote per person per app per week. Votes reset. Nothing is hidden. The homepage Spotlight is paid, on purpose. If you want the top slot, you buy it. If someone wants it more, they outbid you — 1.5× the current weekly rate, hard cap $1,000/week. You lose the slot. No refund. I built it because I ship iOS apps and I was tired of “discovery” meaning ads.

posts.name: Bruce
posts.tagline: A change intelligence layer for AI coding agents
posts.description: Bruce gives AI coding agents the cross-repo context they can't see on their own. An open-source CLI, backed by a hosted dashboard, Bruce tracks breaking changes across your APIs and databases and tells whichever agent is about to touch affected code exactly what broke, how severe it is, and what to do instead — called mid-task, a tool that fits to the existing development workflow when using AI.

posts.name: Dosefolio
posts.tagline: Private log of doses, sites, protein, symptoms, weight.
posts.description: Dosefolio keeps clinician-provided regimen details and the doses you administer on the iPhone. Related wellness notes stay in one place. Export a date-range PDF when you choose to share. Health records stay local. Not a clinic portal.

posts.name: Douze
posts.tagline: Control any dashboard from ChatGPT
posts.description: Douze turns a website you're already signed in to into MCP tools your assistant can call. Hit "Watch this site", do the task once, and Douze infers tools from that tab's API traffic. You review every candidate - grouped as reads, writes and destructive - and approve only what to expose. Calls then run inside your own browser session: no API keys, no scraping, no re-auth. Passwords, cookies and tokens are redacted before capture. Works with ChatGPT, Claude or a local MCP client. Open source.

posts.name: Solenta
posts.tagline: Shared memory for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor & Grok
posts.description: One shared memory across every agent, and a planboard that is your GitHub issues. Agent six begins knowing what agents one through five already ruled out.

posts.name: DevTrace
posts.tagline: The AI collaboration signal, not the score
posts.description: DevTrace is an AI-collaboration assessment platform. Give candidates a real coding task with AI available, and get an AI-generated insight into how they think, prompt, and iterate not just whether the tests pass.

posts.name: Make a Hug
posts.tagline: Send a digital care package in one private link
posts.description: Make a Hug turns notes, photos, voice messages, songs, videos, drawings, places, gift links, coupons, and good news into a private digital care package. Preview it, pay $0.99, and send one link—no account or app required.

posts.name: Kaestral
posts.tagline: An AI-operated video editor. 52 tools. 100% local.
posts.description: You describe the edit. It makes it. Kaestral watches your footage, hears every word, and cuts, an AI-native video editor for Windows. A real multi-track timeline driven by 52 MCP tools and 25 editing skills, from Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, or the built-in chat. Everything runs local, your footage never leaves your PC. Free, open-source, no watermarks.

posts.name: ARKN
posts.tagline: Protect sensitive data before it reaches AI
posts.description: ARKN protects sensitive information before it reaches AI. It detects PII, credentials, and business-sensitive data locally in your browser, replace

posts.name: Contexter
posts.tagline: One context for every AI — and everyone you work with
posts.description: Collect thoughts and materials from Telegram, group chats, ChatGPT, and Claude into a single context. Share it, build on it together, and work with it using your preferred AI. Architecture notes, backlogs, work logs, raw ideas, tickets, or a travel itinerary—the format doesn’t matter; the accumulated meaning does. Ask an LLM, and it turns that context into a summary, a decision history, or next steps. Now early access.

posts.name: Vectask
posts.tagline: Project management that gets out of your way
posts.description: Fast, focused project management for teams who ship. Tasks, projects, cycles, and nothing more. Kanban, backlog and timeline views, automatic GitHub issue and PR sync, and a full REST API. Free plan available, Pro from €6.50/user/mo, or self-host.

posts.name: Vectask
posts.tagline: Project management that gets out of your way
posts.description: Fast, focused project management for teams who ship. Tasks, projects, cycles, and nothing more. Kanban, backlog and timeline views, automatic GitHub issue and PR sync, and a full REST API. Free plan available, Pro from €6.50/user/mo, or self-host.

posts.name: Todo Agents
posts.tagline: simply create a todos for you and your agent
posts.description: Stop feeding your coding agent one prompt at a time. Queue up tasks as you go through your app for review — your agent picks up over a simple REST API and reports back on every task. Easy to working with your non-technical team mate, QA, designer and PO with project based permission.

posts.name: BroPay
posts.tagline: Create stablecoin payment links in seconds
posts.description: BroPay is a free Chrome extension for creating short USDT and USDC payment links. Set the network, amount, and recipient address, then share one link with a QR code and public on-chain status. No payer account is required.

posts.name: Nitrogen Developer Stack
posts.tagline: A complete open-source TypeScript development stack
posts.description: Build modern TypeScript applications with one cohesive toolchain. Nitrogen brings together Lex for project workflows, GothamJS for React 19 interfaces, ArkhamJS for predictable state, MetropolisJS for typed API integration, and Reaktor for application services—each with complete documentation and a focused developer experience.

posts.name: Crankshaft
posts.tagline: Music discovery that reads your taste, not your data
posts.description: Crankshaft reads how you actually listen and surfaces songs that fit your real taste — deep cuts included — entirely on your device. No account, no tracking, nothing leaves your phone. Built solo, for Apple Music. A human in the loop instead of an algorithm guessing - and that human is you.

posts.name: AI Leverage Field Guide
posts.tagline: Free AI workflow guides for professionals who hate hype
posts.description: A free, interactive field guide that teaches working professionals — managers, writers, operators — to get more out of AI without becoming AI experts. Learn the Leverage Loop, generate falsifiable stop conditions with the built-in builder, and follow a 10-week curriculum across five role tracks. Everything runs in your browser: no account, nothing transmitted. Open source (CC-BY-4.0), every idea traced to a catalog of 188 books.v

posts.name: EyeMole
posts.tagline: Whack-a-mole where your stare is the hammer
posts.description: EyeMole is whack-a-mole you play with your eyes. TrueDepth tracks your gaze — stare at a mole and the hammer drops. No tapping, no swiping. The twist: looking is both how you check a hole and how you hit it. A chick pops up sometimes, and staring a beat too long whacks it and costs time. • A gold mole reads your gaze and surfaces in your blind spot • 60-second rounds, combos and a Game Center leaderboard, all by gaze • Face data never leaves your device Free. Needs a Face ID iPhone or iPad.

posts.name: Medical Scribe
posts.tagline: Ambient AI scribing for modern clinicians.
posts.description: Medical Scribe is a simple, affordable AI scribe built for clinicians who want to spend less time documenting and more time with patients. Unlike enterprise-focused alternatives, it works with any EHR and requires no sales calls, contracts, or complicated setup. It generates structured clinical notes in seconds, supports custom templates for different specialties and workflows, and is HIPAA compliant. Sign up and start using it in minutes.

posts.name: Local Photo Restore
posts.tagline: Make old family photos clearer, privately on your iPhone
posts.description: Local Photo Restore improves clarity and resolution in old, faded, yellowed, or low-resolution family photos without uploading them. Choose a photo or photograph a print, enhance it, adjust yellow tint and faded existing color, compare before and after, and save a new copy. The original stays untouched. There is no account, photo-processing server, advertising, analytics, or third-party tracking. This first release does not colorize black-and-white photos or reconstruct scratches and damage.

posts.name: Kept: Task & Habit Tracker
posts.tagline: When did I do that?
posts.description: Kept is a simple tracker built for people who want to log what they did without distractions. No streaks, no reminders, no urgency. Just clear, quiet tracking with timestamps, optional comments, images, or location. It keeps data private, on your device or iCloud, and syncs across iPhone, Mac, iPad, and watchOS. The paid plan adds location logging, custom widgets, watch complications, and more.

posts.name: RequestPlayer
posts.tagline: Let your guests request the music.
posts.description: RequestPlayer turns Apple Music into a shared music experience. Create a request room with your favorite playlists, albums, or artists, then invite guests with a link or QR code. Guests can request and like songs right from their browser — no app required. Play requests in order, by likes, or arrange the queue yourself. Simple, social, and completely free to use.

posts.name: Escale
posts.tagline: Ship iOS and Android apps from one native macOS workspace
posts.description: Bring App Store Connect and Google Play into one local-first macOS workspace. Manage listings, screenshots, localization, reviews, releases, and regional pricing through official APIs. Escale Community is free and open source.

posts.name: Waivly
posts.tagline: Share your offering to ambitious professionals
posts.description: Connect, learn, and grow in the private global network built for meaningful relationships, new opportunities, and lasting progress.

posts.name: Bite4: Health Food Tracker
posts.tagline: Macro Log & Food Scan
posts.description: Bite4 is a minimalist health food tracker designed to help you build better food habits without calorie counting. Keep just four active food categories on screen so your daily progress stays simple, focused, and easy to maintain. Scan a food photo or type in a food name to get category suggestions, then log it in one tap. Bite4 helps you stay consistent with a clean, fast workflow that fits into your day.

posts.name: Price Point Parity
posts.tagline: Worldwide price localiser
posts.description: Price Point Parity connects to App Store Connect to set in-app purchase and subscription prices across ~175 territories at once. Choose a base region and strategy, preview, fine-tune, then publish. Strategies include local purchasing power, equal proceeds, blended, Apple pricing, or copying another product. macOS users can automate updates, apply adjustments, charm pricing, minimum proceeds, and translate product information.

posts.name: Free Photo Collage Maker
posts.tagline: Combine 2–6 photos into a collage in your browser
posts.description: Photo Collage Maker is a free browser-based tool for combining 2–6 photos into one collage. Adjust each image individually, customize the spacing and color, then export your finished collage as JPG, WebP, or PNG.

posts.name: Valkence Social - Talk Internet Culture
posts.tagline: Connect around what matters, free from algorithms and bots
posts.description: Connect around what matters, free from algorithms and bots.

posts.name: TikTok Unfollow AI
posts.tagline: Mass unfollow everyone on TikTok who doesn't follow back
posts.description: Most TikTok unfollow tools hand you a button and no picture of what you're about to do. This one shows the whole list first: every account you follow, labelled one-way, mutual, verified or private. Then you pick the scope — everyone, only the non-followers, or just the accounts you tick. What's different: shield an account and no bulk action can ever reach it. And you set the pace, 3 seconds to 5 minutes — it stops on its own if TikTok pushes back. No TikTok password. 52 languages.

posts.name: Super Garbage Truck Game for iOS
posts.tagline: Retro garbage truck game for all ages.
posts.description: SUPER GARBAGE TRUCK is the retro garbage truck game where you pick-up trash to win! Drive through 10 unique cities of different size, weather, and obstacles as you dodge cars and collect all the trash to complete the level.

posts.name: MTL Exits
posts.tagline: Know the right car, door, and exit... starting in Montréal.
posts.description: MTL Exits helps Montréal Metro riders choose the route, direction, train car, door, transfer position, and street exit to aim for. It’s bilingual, free, needs no account, and keeps core route and exit guidance available offline.

posts.name: Krino
posts.tagline: Fraud and AML decisions you can explain, inside your walls
posts.description: Most fraud tools are black boxes you ship customer data to. Krino inverts both. It runs inside your infrastructure — transactions, devices, enrichment and sanctions lists never leave. Analysts build rules visually, shadow-test a draft against live traffic to see what it would change, then publish. No deploy. Every decision comes back rule by rule, with the data as it was — replayable months later. The AI assistant runs on your model and key, read-only, PII stripped before it leaves.

posts.name: Medical Scribe
posts.tagline: Ambient AI scribing for modern clinicians.
posts.description: Medical Scribe is a simple, affordable AI scribe built for clinicians who want to spend less time documenting and more time with patients. Unlike enterprise-focused alternatives, it works with any EHR and requires no sales calls, contracts, or complicated setup. It generates structured clinical notes in seconds, supports custom templates for different specialties and workflows, and is HIPAA compliant. Sign up and start using it in minutes.

posts.name: SuppyHQ
posts.tagline: Customer support inbox. Stop typing the same answers.
posts.description: Most support tools try to get you out of the conversation. That's backwards. The refund, the apology, the exception: that's the relationship. You should be there. SuppyHQ is a customer support inbox for founders and small teams who still answer themselves. Past answers show up in the composer. Plan and LTV sit next to the thread. Long threads get a summary. You hit send. No bot pretending to be you. Customer support is still your job. The typing doesn't have to be.

posts.name: JustQuickTools
posts.tagline: Professional resumes in minutes
posts.description: Free online resume builder with over 9 professional themes. No sign-up required. Build a beautiful resume in minutes, customize colors, and download it as a PDF.

posts.name: MyCityBid
posts.tagline: Support your city, get discovered — become Champion
posts.description: MyCityBid — Support Your City. Get Discovered. The leaderboard where backing your hometown puts you on its wall forever — and the top backer becomes City Champion. 9,223 real cities in 195 countries, ranked by total raised. How it works: Find your city Back it from $5 — name + link live on its wall as a Permanent City Wall Listing Top backer becomes City Champion — throne + deep link on the city page & country leaderboard Everyone gets a sponsored link, not just the Champion. Join from $5.

posts.name: Vorssaint
posts.tagline: Free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit.
posts.description: A free, open-source menu bar app built around your Mac. Install only the tools you use, remove the rest, and keep everything local.

posts.name: banalo.business
posts.tagline: Your AI co-founder for building and launching D2C brands.
posts.description: Banalo is your AI co-founder for building and launching D2C brands. From affordable to luxury suppliers, discover everything you need in one place: products, bottles, packaging, branding, websites and more. Start with perfumes today, with more categories like clothing, jewellery, skincare and beyond coming soon.

posts.name: Sevidesk
posts.tagline: Scale support with AI — faster, unified, and human at heart
posts.description: Sevidesk flips the pricing model entirely — flat-rate plans, not per-seat taxes. We're the only platform that lets you Bring Your Own OpenAI Key with zero markup, plus built-in guardrails so you don't need an ops person to manage it. Our chatbot doesn't deflect — it actually closes tickets. And our intelligent chat interface adapts in real-time: showing customers exactly when agents are online, when it's after-hours AI, or when AI is always-on. Setup takes minutes, not a technical degree.

posts.name: Oliver's Army
posts.tagline: Discord for Politics
posts.description: The social media companies are lying to you.

posts.name: Math Realm
posts.tagline: Math Realm Makes Learning Math Fun.
posts.description: My son is building this app. It was so popular it got banned at his school. Real PMF amongst his cohort. Kids who hate math will do it if you make it a game and reward progression. Free to use. His gift to the world.

posts.name: The Best Tapa
posts.tagline: Spain's tapas, ranked by people who were actually there
posts.description: Find the best tapas in Spain, city by city. Anyone can add a tapa from anywhere in the world: photo, bar, publish. Voting works differently. You can only vote while you are in that city, so every ranking is built by people who actually ate the dish. No paid placements, no promoted bars, no sponsored positions. Open your city, see what is at the top, and go settle the argument.

posts.name: ProcurelyOS
posts.tagline: An app to help procurement teams find products for projects.
posts.description: ProcurelyOS helps procurement teams find suppliers, compare options, prepare outreach campaigns, and help with following up to each supplier.

posts.name: PDF Deckle
posts.tagline: Every PDF tool you need
posts.description: 42 PDF tools that run entirely inside your browser. No upload, no account, no page limits. Convert, organise, edit, secure, optimise and truly redact — offline.

posts.name: Spotted.gg
posts.tagline: Never miss a Counter-Strike match again
posts.description: Subscribe to a Tier 1 Counter-Strike team. We email or ping your Discord 10 minutes before they play. Set it once, never check HLTV again. 26 teams tracked. Match times refresh every 5 minutes and get re-checked right before the alert fires, so a rescheduled match doesn't send you the wrong time. There's a calendar feed too if you'd rather have the whole schedule in Google Calendar. Free, no app to install.

posts.name: Family Activity Finder
posts.tagline: UK days out matched to your kids, weather and budget
posts.description: Enter a UK postcode and your children’s ages to get local day-out ideas matched to the forecast. Filter by distance, budget, transport and accessibility, then compare options on a map. Free on web, iOS and Android.

posts.name: Velastar
posts.tagline: Explore the real sky - from Earth to alien worlds
posts.description: Velastar is a native iOS sky atlas built with Metal and a testable Swift astronomy core. Point your iPhone at the real sky, explore 8,002 Hipparcos stars and all 88 constellations, move through time and location, or change your observing world entirely. Land on the Moon, Mars, or Europa to see local horizons, solar time, planets, and moons. It also includes a 3D Solar System, offline object guides, Milky Way planning, light-pollution tools, world clocks, and six astronomy widgets.

posts.name: ZenReel
posts.tagline: Turn your ideas into professional video shorts in minutes
posts.description: ZenReel helps professionals, creators, educators, founders and businesses turn their ideas into engaging short-form videos without the usual production work. Describe your topic or idea, and ZenReel handles the production — from script and visuals to voice, captions and the final reel. You bring the expertise. ZenReel handles the production.

posts.name: freelanceonthebench.lol
posts.tagline: Freelancers and agencies, ranked by live value.
posts.description: Available freelancers and agencies, ranked by live value. Burns 10% a day, the top is whoever's actually free. This is simple as it is

posts.name: Meikyu
posts.tagline: A daily dungeon puzzle with hidden rules to deduce
posts.description: Five residents make up today’s hidden dungeon lineup. You get six tries to name them and put each one in the right slot. Every sortie leaves a report: who is right, who belongs elsewhere, and who is not on the floor. Across days, you also uncover the residents’ unwritten house rules.

posts.name: Dolthub
posts.tagline: The only version-controlled database company. Git for Data.
posts.description: Dolt is a version-controlled SQL database for AI agents and developers. Think Git and MySQL had a baby: every database change can be committed, branched, diffed, merged, pushed, and pulled. Agents can work on isolated branches, review database changes before they reach production, and roll back mistakes with a complete history of both data and schema. Dolt is open source and MySQL-compatible, with related projects for SQLite (DoltLite), PostgreSQL (Doltgres), and MongoDB workflows (DumboDB).
